notes.title: Prente Art Market 2025
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45305400/1436bb2b36f51e0a7511123b523c3e79079c030e.png"][/img][/p][h2]Showcasing Our Indie Game at Prente 2025[/h2][p]We’re bringing [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3346410/Club_Soko/"][b]Club Soko[/b][/url] to one of the raddest Art Fairs around,[b] [url="https://www.instagram.com/prenteartmarket/"]Prente![/url] [/b]Located in the coastal town of Knokke-Heist in Belgium[b] [/b]On [b]August 16th.[/b] Our tiny team will be setting up a stand for an awesome showcase of true underground creatives.[/p][p]The event is bursting with punk zine-makers, game artists, forward thinkers on the frontline of true creative expression. Building on everything we learnt from Rapture Gaming Festival earlier this month, we'll be showing off a new build of the game with a bunch of improvements from that showcase so we're looking forward to seeing how people get on the new build.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45305400/f7bfae25348bbb7052f16b9b21deea6b57879fb1.png"][/img][/p][h2]Custom Controller[/h2][p]Also, we're in the process of building this rad custom controller specially tailored for Club Soko when we're showcasing at events! Everything is hand-modded with arcade parts specially for Club Soko and handmade with upcycled second hand charity shop finds. We're hoping that once the controller is painted up this will give the stand a real slick touch to make it feel more inviting to play! Check out some of the process so far...[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45305400/daf4faa0c983db5bc206e2045c1c1803cc91dc07.png"][/img][/p][p]If you're into hand-drawn puzzles, experimental controllers, or just want to chat with some artists, come hang out! We’ll have a bunch of free stuff you can get your hands on! Club Soko has come a long way in recent months, and we’re using events like [b][url="https://www.instagram.com/prenteartmarket/"]Prente[/url][/b] to gather feedback, meet like-minded folks, and find a cool audience for the game.[/p][p]If you check out the build and like what you see, we’d love it if you [b][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3346410/Club_Soko/"]wishlisted the game on Steam[/url][/b] or joined our [b][url="https://discord.com/invite/MYWmsNQ"]Discord[/url][/b] to chat and hang out and follow along![/p][p]See you at Prente![/p][p]— Miracle Tea Devs[/p]

notes.title: Rapture Gaming Fest 2025
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45305400/e42d57b6cb93a554a9c8b47e1b4292d3681d8bdc.png"][/img][/p][p]We're happy to announce that [i]Club Soko[/i] will be [b][url="https://rapturegamingfestival.com/"]playable at Rapture Gaming Fest[/url][/b][url="https://rapturegamingfestival.com/"] [/url]this weekend in Colchester! If our materials arrive on time expect to get your hands on some cool stickers and an little A5 print of the game[/p][p]If you're attending, come hang out by our booth to check out the latest version of [b]Club Soko![/b] We're looking to get as much feedback and playtesting done on the build as possible! We're hoping that we can improve the game a whole bunch after Rapture Gaming Festival in the lead up to another public showcase of the game again later in August, [url="https://www.instagram.com/prenteartmarket/"][b]Prente![/b][/url][/p][p]Some of our development team will be there in person to chat, answer questions, and soak in your feedback, so be kind but honest![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45305400/7510704514397d29d5e49a35380cd3bb1bae8642.png"][/img][/p][p]If you unable to make it to Rapture Gaming Festival this weekend but are really keen to try out the game, give us a message on our [url="https://discord.com/invite/MYWmsNQ"][b]Discord[/b][/url][url="https://discord.com/invite/MYWmsNQ"] [/url]and we might be able to provide access to the latest build for some playtesting. In the meantime, you can also still [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3507130/Club_Soko_Demo/"][b]play an early version of the demo on Steam right now[/b][/url][b] [/b]from earlier in the year[b].[/b] The game has come a long way since this demo but feel free to let us know what you think so far![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45305400/2685d8e05d1903a7e0f3602ab00b3e94c65a7683.png"][/img][/p][p]If you happen to play Club Soko at Rapture and enjoyed the demo, we’d love it if you [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3346410/Club_Soko/"][b]wishlisted[/b][/url] the game or left us a quick note on the [url="https://steamcommunity.com/app/3346410/discussions/"][b]Steam Discussion Board[/b][/url] - it really helps our tiny team grow. [url="https://emojipedia.org/black-heart"][u]🖤[/u][/url][/p][p]RIP Ozzy and see you all this weekend![/p][p]- Miracle Tea Devs[/p]

notes.title: Club Soko - Steam Deck Compatibility
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45305400/7a4c4551be01b4109d6f3f322bae0a396a9220b0.png[/img]

As we're nearing closer and closer to the [url=https://www.cerebralpuzzleshowcase.com/][b]Cerebral Puzzle Showcase[/b][/url], we're expecting lots of new players to be checking out our demo. So we thought we'd take the opportunity to let you all know that Club Soko is Steam Deck Playable!

We only have the one Steam Deck currently available so if you played Club Soko on the Deck, please let us know how you got on with it in our [url=https://discord.com/invite/MYWmsNQ][b]Discord[/b][/url] or the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/3346410/discussions/][b]Discussion Board[/b][/url] here on Steam. We're curious to know how the experience was for new users booting it up for the first time as we're continuing to test and optimise for full verification.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45305400/3228da46029b3461cff9234a23ce325f1e41fbfd.gif[/img]

If the experience was good for you and you get a prompt to rate the game for Steam Deck compatibility that will really help us out in working toward that green checkmark ✅ We're not officially Steam Deck Verified just yet, but we're working on it!

In the meantime, controls and a clean UI for handheld play should work so enjoy!

- Miracle Tea Devs

notes.title: Cerebral Puzzle Showcase 2025
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45305400/13a56ca0177802f6cfc503798e20f6312aa1cfb6.png[/img]

We’re excited to share that Club Soko is officially part of this year’s Cerebral Puzzle Showcase on Steam! 

The event runs from [b]May 29th to June 5th[/b] and highlights thoughtful, inventive, and brain-teasing puzzle games — we’re stoked to be featured alongside so many lovely indie games. Since we found out we've been busy working on a special update for the demo that we plan to drop just in time for the event, so keep your eyes peeled for that!

The showcase also includes a livestream event running from [b]May 29–June 1[/b], with streamers diving into select games from the lineup. Keep an eye on the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/CerebralPuzzleShowcase]Cerebral Puzzle Showcase page on Steam![/url]

[previewyoutube=bDO5VuA5FrY;full][/previewyoutube]

Thank you for all the support and kind words about the game so far! See you at the showcase!

– Miracle Tea devs

notes.title: Club Soko - Box-Pushing Fest
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45305400/6d3c3265aa931b3af6839fc4343958f65e7f3189.png[/img]

[h2]Box-Pushing Fest [/h2]
Steam's Box-Pushing Fest has been awesome! We got a ton of playtesting and feedback on Club Soko and have already learnt so much! Thanks to all of our internal playtester friends and fellow devs who suggested tweaks and improvements that helped make the demo the best it could be leading up to the event.


[previewyoutube=EDuTgwSPqjw;full][/previewyoutube]

We made an exclusive [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3507130/Club_Soko_Demo/]demo[/url] and a little demo release trailer just for this event which you can watch below.

[previewyoutube=YHiaNNTcXJc;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Everything Is A Remix[/h2]
Back in November we made Club Soko for the [url=https://gamejamplus.com/crazywebgamejam2024/]Crazy Games Web Jam[/url] under the theme 'Everything Is A Remix'. We specifically picked the Sokoban subgenre just so we could have a demo ready in time for Steam's Box-Pushing Fest. Lo and behold we just about pulled it off and are stoked by this personal milestone!

[h2]The Demo[/h2]
Not only did we manage to squeeze about 20 minutes of gameplay for our players, Club Soko has full controller support and runs really well on Steam Deck already.

If you played the Club Soko demo on Steam Deck, we'd love to hear what you thought — come chat with us on our [url=https://discord.com/invite/MYWmsNQ]Discord[/url]!

Thanks to everyone that has played, reviewed and added Club Soko to their wishlist so far!

- Miracle Tea
